_README: REGISTRY DUY NHAT khai bao CLI provider cho bin/dispatch.sh.
Them 1 CLI moi = them 1 entry o day. KHONG sua dispatch.sh.
QUY TAC CUNG (arch-reviewer 2026-08-03, required_change #2):
File nay chi chua FIELD de TRA CUU. No KHONG BAO GIO chua/van chuyen argv.
argv duoc dung bang ARRAY bash ngay trong _bg_wrapper (ham _build_argv cua
dispatch.sh). Ly do da do thuc nghiem: NUL bi $( ) nuot (len=3 cho a\0b\0c) va
array bash KHONG vuot duoc `bash -c '_bg_wrapper'` (export arr => declare: not found).
Moi duong di qua eval chuoi = tai sinh lop loi quoting §15 coding_guidelines.
CACH DUNG:
bin/cli_provider.sh field <provider> <key>      # tra 1 field, exit 1 neu thieu
bin/cli_provider.sh list                        # provider dang enabled
bin/cli_provider.sh check <provider>            # chay <bin> --version => phan biet
# 'PROVIDER HONG' voi 'task loi'
bin/cli_provider.sh validate <provider> <agent> <model> <effort>
FIELD:
enabled        : false => dispatch.sh tu choi, KHONG bao gio am tham roi ve claude
bin            : duong dan tuyet doi toi binary
bin_env_override: ten bien env duoc phep de len `bin` (giu DISPATCH_CLAUDE_BIN song,
neu khong dispatch_discord_topic_selfcheck.sh tat den — F11)
env            : bien moi truong bo sung. Ho tro ${PATH} de noi chuoi.
⚠️ BAT BUOC cho CLI dang shim `#!/usr/bin/env node`: pin `bin` KHONG
pin interpreter. Do that duoi PATH crontab: codex -> SyntaxError vi
/usr/bin/node = v12.22.9 < engines>=16. opencode KHONG can (ELF native).
default_model  : model dung khi caller KHONG truyen --model. null => khong truyen co
nao (claude: CLI tu lay tu agents/<id>/.claude/settings.json).
supports_turns : false => dispatch.sh BO HAN nhanh max-turns resume, khong bia
profile        : cach nap identity cua agent (xem bang duoi)
usage_probe    : script uoc luong usage. null => CHI phrase-match, khong doi chung,
khong doan gio reset. bin/usage_watch.py doc ~/.claude/projects nen
CHI dung cho claude — dung cho provider khac la doc nham tai khoan.
fallback_provider: provider chuyen sang khi provider nay HET QUOTA. BAT DOI XUNG CO Y:
opencode/codex/agy -> claude la NANG CAP nang luc (claude co write/edit,
tier suy luan cao hon) => an toan, bat mac dinh.
claude -> opencode la HA CAP (mat han tool write/edit, co the ha tier)
=> de null, PHAI opt-in tung lan bang `--fallback opencode`.
usage_limit_pattern: regex nhan dang loi het quota RIENG cua provider do (wording moi CLI
moi khac). '@bin/usage_limit_phrases.sh' = dung list dung chung cua claude.
⚠️ Pattern cua opencode/codex/agy CHUA quan sat duoc loi that — dat theo
ma loi HTTP/API pho bien, can sua lai khi gap loi that dau tien.
allow_agents   : '*' hoac list. ⚠️ Day la DAI THU HAI, khong phai co che chinh.
No CHI chan o dispatch.sh — agent co Bash van goi thang binary duoc.
Cuong che THAT nam o `permission` trong agents/<id>/opencode.json
(da kiem chung 2026-08-03: bash deny-by-default + allowlist chan
duoc `echo > file`, tra loi sach trong 7s, --auto KHONG de len deny).
PROFILE — cach agent nhan identity + context:
claude-native : cd vao agents/<id>/ => Claude Code tu nap CLAUDE.md + @import +
CLAUDE.md to tien. Khong can lam gi them.
opencode-json : opencode doc CLAUDE.md tu --dir (da kiem chung), nhung KHONG hieu
@import => danh sach file context khai bao trong agents/<id>/opencode.json
field `instructions` (duong dan tuyet doi). Da kiem chung nap dung.
prompt-inline : provider khong doc file profile nao cua fleet (codex doc AGENTS.md chu
khong doc CLAUDE.md; agy khong doc file nao) => dispatch.sh prepend
identity+context vao PROMPT bang bin/render_profile_prompt.sh.
NANG CAP nvm/node lam `bin` va `env` lech: `check` se bao LOUD luc dispatch.
Sua o day, dung sua rai rac trong script.

claude.label: Claude Code
claude.notes: Mac dinh. Duy nhat duoc dung cho surface tien that (Mafee/DollarBill) va dieu phoi (Mike/Wags).

opencode.label: opencode (SST) — Zen free tier
notes: ELF binary native => CHAY DUOC duoi PATH crontab (da do: in 1.18.11, rc=0). Khac codex.
Zen free tier chay voi 0 credentials (da do). KHONG dam bao do tre: da quan sat 1 lan
treo >150s roi lan sau xong trong 6s. => KHONG dung cho viec tren duong gang van hanh
(plan T+1, EOD report). Chi research/doi-chung.
effort anh xa sang --variant. turns khong co flag (co `steps` trong agent config).

codex.label: OpenAI Codex CLI
notes: enabled=false cho toi khi user chay `codex login` (da kiem 2026-08-03: Not logged in).
env.PATH BAT BUOC: codex la shim `#!/usr/bin/env node`, engines>=16, ma /usr/bin/node
la v12.22.9 => duoi PATH crontab no chet SyntaxError. Da do ca 2 chieu:
co nvm bin trong PATH -> 'codex-cli 0.146.0' rc=0 ; khong co -> SyntaxError.
profile=prompt-inline: codex doc AGENTS.md chu khong doc CLAUDE.md, va fleet khong co
AGENTS.md nao => context phai prepend vao prompt. CHUA WIRE, lam khi user login xong.
Sandbox: dung -s read-only / workspace-write, KHONG dung
--dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox (arch-reviewer required_change #6c).

antigravity.label: Google Antigravity CLI (agy) — Gemini
notes: enabled=false: `agy` CHUA CAI tren may nay va ~/.gemini chua ton tai (kiem 2026-08-03).
Bat khi: (1) cai agy tu github google-antigravity/antigravity-cli, (2) user login Gemini
hoac dat GEMINI_API_KEY, (3) doi bin= duong dan tuyet doi that, (4) enabled=true.
CLI contract lay tu NGUON CO THAM QUYEN — src/adapter.rs:611-634 cua agy-acp.zip:

agy --add-dir --log-file

--print-timeout [--conversation ID] [--model M] -p
Tuc `agy -p` la headless print mode giong `claude -p` => cam thang vao dispatch.sh duoc.
models=[] CO Y de rong: chua cai agy nen KHONG the liet ke that (`agy models`). Rong =>
validate BO QUA kiem model, khong chan. Khi cai xong: chay `agy models` roi dien vao day
— dung doan ten model.
⚠️ VI SAO KHONG DUNG agy-acp (file mike/agy-acp.zip user cung cap):
agy-acp la ACP stdio adapter (JSON-RPC) de cam `agy` vao ACP HOST tuong tac nhu Zed
Agent Panel. Chinh README cua no ghi: no SPAWN `agy` lam subprocess va dung `agy --print`
lam nguon cau tra loi cuoi. Fleet minh dispatch la one-shot headless, khong dung streaming
session/update lan session resume — nen goi thang `agy` don gian hon va KHONG MAT GI.
Di duong ACP se phai: cai Rust toolchain + build binary + viet 1 ACP CLIENT (JSON-RPC
stdio) trong dispatch.sh — nhieu viec, them 1 tien trinh trung gian, de doi lay tinh nang
fleet khong dung. Zip van giu lai o mike/agy-acp.zip: dung khi muon dung agy TRONG Zed,
hoac neu sau nay can streaming/session-resume that su.
